  {

    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": "wide-bandgap perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 27.11, "unit": "%", "anchor": "to achieve a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.3, "unit": "%", "anchor": "to achieve a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%)"},
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A localized 2D/3D perovskite heterojunction was engineered at the buried interface via Lewis acid-base interactions between a hole-selective self-assembled monolayer and ammonium ligands.", "anchor": "we explore intricate Lewis acid-base interactions between hole-selective self-assembled monolayer and ammonium ligands to engineer a localized 2D/3D perovskite heterojunction at the buried interface", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Photovoltages of 1.30, 1.38, and 1.42 V were obtained for 1.68, 1.79, and 1.85 eV bandgap perovskite solar cells, exceeding 90% of their thermodynamic limits.", "anchor": "These resulted in 1.30, 1.38, and 1.42 V photovoltages for 1.68, 1.79, and 1.85 eV bandgap perovskite solar cells, respectively, all exceeding 90% of their thermodynamic limits.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Monolithic perovskite-organic tandem solar cells were fabricated by integrating the optimized wide-bandgap perovskite cell with an organic subcell.", "anchor": "We also demonstrate high-efficiency monolithic tandem solar cells by integrating the optimized wide-bandgap perovskite solar cell with an organic subcell to achieve a PCE of 27.11% (certified 26.3%).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "3D/2D-amidinium perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 25.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "pce_stabilised": {"value": 25.4, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 1.1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "inverted 3D/2D-amidinium perovskite solar cells deliver 25.4% power conversion efficiency (1.1 square centimeters, steady-state certified)"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A controllable 1D-to-2D structural transition was achieved in low-dimensional perovskites by tuning amidinium ligand conformation.", "anchor": "we introduce a controllable one- to two-dimensional (1D-to-2D) structural transition strategy by systematically tuning ligand conformation, thereby modulating hydrogen bonding, π-π stacking, and basicity to elucidate the relationship between molecular structure, interfacial interactions, and resulting dimensionality", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The 2D-amidinium perovskite forms a continuous, homogeneous interfacial layer that enables more effective defect passivation and favorable energy-level alignment.", "anchor": "In contrast, the 2D-amidinium perovskite forms a continuous, homogeneous interfacial layer, enabling more effective defect passivation and favorable energy-level alignment.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices maintain >95% of their initial efficiency after 1100 hours of continuous 1-sun operation at 85°C.", "anchor": "maintain >95% of their initial efficiency after 1100 hours of continuous 1-sun operation at 85°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.6, "unit": "%", "anchor": "This strategy enabled n-i-p perovskite solar cells to achieve a PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.5%)."},
    "pce_certified": {"value": 26.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "This strategy enabled n-i-p perovskite solar cells to achieve a PCE of 26.6% (certified 26.5%)."},
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-3, ISOS-D-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Molecular press annealing thermally and pressure-bonds a 2-pyridylethylamine film to the perovskite surface during annealing.", "anchor": "We demonstrate a molecular press annealing (MPA) strategy in which a 2-pyridylethylamine film is thermally and pressure-bonded to the perovskite surface.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Iodine vacancies are healed in real time during annealing while the lead-iodine framework is stabilized.", "anchor": "Real-time healing of iodine vacancies occurred during annealing and the lead-iodine framework was stabilized through optimized ligand engineering, resulting in enhanced structural integrity and long-term stability of perovskite films.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 98.6% and 97.2% of initial PCE after 1617 h MPPT operation (ISOS-L-3, 85°C, 60% RH) and 5280 h ambient storage (ISOS-D-1), respectively.", "anchor": "the devices retain 98.6 and 97.2% of their initial PCEs after 1617 hours of continuous operation under maximum power point tracking [ISOS-L-3 protocol, 85°C, 60% relative humidity (RH)] and 5280 hours of ambient storage (ISOS-D-1 protocol, room temperature, 10% RH)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The resulting TiO 2 @SnO 2 p-MPSCs achieve a well improved champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 22.5%."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 0.1, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "thereby enabling a PCE of 22.5% and 18.8% for 0.1-cm 2 and 57.33-cm 2 devices"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A TiO2@SnO2 bilayer mesoporous electron transport layer was formed by low-temperature chemical bath deposition on the preformed triple mesoporous scaffold.", "anchor": "the conformal SnO 2 coating is formed without experiencing high-temperature annealing suffering, thus circumventing associated electronic property degradation", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The bilayer mp-ETL scales to 57.33 cm2 minimodules with 18.8% PCE.", "anchor": "The bilayer mp-ETL also demonstrates scalability with 18.8% PCE achieved in 57.33-cm 2 minimodules.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Encapsulated devices retain 90% efficiency after 2000 h of maximum power point tracking under continuous illumination at 55 ± 5 °C.", "anchor": "encapsulated devices exhibit good operational stability, with 90% efficiency retained after 2000-h maximum power point tracking under continuous illumination at 55 ± 5 °C", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "CsPbIxBr3-x",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 12.16, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the optimized device (5 mg/mL IDA) delivers a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 12.16%, representing a significant absolute enhancement of 3.38% over the unmodified control (8.78%)"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Iminodiacetic acid was incorporated as a multifunctional dopant into hydrothermally synthesized TiO2 ETLs to passivate defects at the bulk, surface, and interface.", "anchor": "This modification enables multidimensional defect passivation at the TiO2 bulk, the surface, and the TiO2/perovskite interface, significantly boosting device performance.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The IDA-modified devices show reduced hysteresis from 0.024 to 0.011 and retain over 82% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous simulated sunlight irradiation.", "anchor": "the modified devices exhibit markedly reduced hysteresis (from 0.024 to 0.011) and superior stability, retaining over 82% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous simulated sunlight irradiation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The imino groups of IDA promote formation of a dense, high-crystallinity CsPbIxBr3-x layer by coordinating uncoordinated Pb2+ ions.", "anchor": "the imino groups facilitate the formation of a dense, high-crystallinity CsPbIxBr3-x perovskite layer through coordination with uncoordinated Pb 2+ ions", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {

    "claims": [
      {"text": "CeO2@MoS2 nanocomposites were inserted as an interfacial buffer layer into a NiOX/MeO-2PACz hole transport layer.", "anchor": "hydrothermally synthesized CeO2@MoS2 nanocomposites (CM NCs) were incorporated as an interfacial buffer layer into a NiOX/MeO-2PACz HTL.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Mo sites in MoS2 interact with NiOX, modulating the Ni2+/Ni3+ ratio and reducing interfacial trap density.", "anchor": "Mo sites in MoS2 interact with NiOX, modulating the Ni2+/Ni3+ ratio and reducing the interfacial trap density", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "Excessive CM NCs loading (4 vol%) increases interfacial resistance and causes partial hole blocking, degrading performance.", "anchor": "excessive CM NCs incorporation (4 vol%) leads to increased interfacial resistance, partial hole blocking effects associated with the n-type nature of CeO2, and aggravated recombination, resulting in degraded device performance.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {

    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A hexagonal nanowire perovskite solar cell design achieves broadband absorption, minimized reflectance, and polarization insensitivity.", "anchor": "we presented an ingenious hexagonal nanowire (HNW)-based PSC that achieves broadband absorption, minimizes reflectance, and offers robust polarization insensitivity by improving light-matter interaction and increasing charge-collection efficiency", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "A dielectric SiO2 sphere partially embedded in the ITO layer improves long-wavelength absorbance and carrier generation near the active region.", "anchor": "a dielectric SiO2 sphere is partially embedded in the ITO layer, improving long-wavelength absorbance and increasing electron-hole pair generation near the active region", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "Optical simulation yields a short-circuit current density of 29.53 mA/cm2.", "anchor": "This study demonstrates that our proposed structure has achieved a higher generation rate, enhanced absorbance, and a higher optical short-circuit current density (Jsc) of 29.53 mA/cm2", "evidence_type": "simulation"}
    ]
  },

    "pce_certified": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The multisite-functionalized thiazole spacer ATAA synergistically heals grain boundaries and realigns energy levels in 2D/3D perovskites.", "anchor": "we designed a multisite‐functionalized thiazole‐based spacer, 2‐(2‐amino‐4‐thiazolyl)acetic acid (ATAA), capable of synergistically healing grain boundaries (GBs) and realigning energy levels in 2D/3D perovskites", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "ATAA upshifts the valence band maximum by 0.12 eV, optimizing interfacial energy alignment.", "anchor": "ATAA upshifts the valence band maximum (VBM) by 0.12 eV, optimizing interfacial energy alignment and facilitating charge extraction", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 91% of initial PCE after 1200 h of maximum power point tracking under ISOS-L-2 continuous illumination.", "anchor": "the devices exhibit outstanding humidity, thermal, and light stability, retaining 91% of the initial PCE after 1 200 h of maximum power point tracking (ISOS‐L‐2 protocol) under continuous illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },

      {"text": "The 3,5-difluoropyridine additive modulates crystallization, yielding films with reduced defect density, suppressed non-radiative recombination, and enhanced phase stability.", "anchor": "3,5‐difluoropyridine (DFPy) additive effectively modulates the crystallization process, yielding perovskite films with reduced defect density, suppressed non‐radiative recombination, and enhanced phase stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The champion inverted device shows Jsc of 25.77 mA/cm2, Voc of 1.18 V, and FF of 85.62%.", "anchor": "the optimized inverted PSCs delivering a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of nearly 26% along with a J SC of 25.77 mA cm −2 , a V OC of 1.18 V, and an FF of 85.62%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },

    "claims": [
      {"text": "During annealing, VPD coordinates Pb2+ and polymerizes in situ into a cross-linked network that suppresses PbI2 formation, converts tensile strain to compressive stress, and directs oriented (100) growth.", "anchor": "During annealing, VPD simultaneously coordinates with Pb 2+ ions and polymerizes in situ into a cross‐linked network, suppressing PbI 2 formation, reprogramming tensile strain into compressive stress, and directing oriented (100) crystal growth", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "VPD-modified devices retain 95% of initial performance after 500 h of continuous operation.", "anchor": "retain 95% of their initial performance after 500 h of continuous operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

    "claims": [
      {"text": "Sodium ethylxanthate treatment in situ forms a water-insoluble PbSO4 surface layer that blocks moisture ingress.", "anchor": "a solid water‐insoluble PbSO 4 layer is in situ formed to block the moisture ingress", "evidence_type": "measurement"},

      {"text": "Devices show >95% PCE retention after 3,800 h storage in N2.", "anchor": "the device stability is also improved with >95% PCE retention after 3,800 h in N 2", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

    "architecture": "p-i-n",

    "pce_certified": null,

    "t80_h": {"value": 500, "unit": "h", "anchor": "maintain 80% after 500 h continuous illumination"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Moderate reverse bias forms an insulating NiI2 interlayer with a Ni-O-Pb intermediate at the buried NiOx/perovskite interface, while higher bias collapses grain boundaries.", "anchor": "moderate reverse bias drives the rapid formation of an electrically insulating NiI 2 interlayer together with a Ni–O–Pb intermediate, while higher bias accelerates grain‐boundary collapse within the perovskite absorber", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The Ol-CzRAA oligomer chelates Ni3+ species to suppress Ni3+ reduction and passivates under-coordinated Pb2+ defects via rhodanine C=S groups.", "anchor": "we design a conjugated oligomer, Ol‐CzRAA , whose carboxyl moieties chelate Ni ≥3+ species to suppress Ni ≥3+ →Ni 2 + reduction and whose rhodanine C═S groups coordinatively passivate under‐coordinated Pb 2+ defects", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Ol-CzRAA devices show a nearly two-order-of-magnitude higher breakdown voltage, retain 83% efficiency after 100 h at -1 V reverse bias, and maintain 80% after 500 h continuous illumination.", "anchor": "devices incorporating Ol‐CzRAA exhibit a breakdown voltage increased by nearly two orders of magnitude, retain 83% of their initial efficiency after 100 h at −1 V reverse bias, and maintain 80% after 500 h continuous illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
